result.title: OmniSenMo: A Unified Multisensory Language Model for Generalizable Human Motion Estimation, Understanding, and Prediction
result.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) estimate, understand, and predict human motion, but mainly from RGB cameras. Depth, LiDAR, mmWave, and WiFi complement RGB under poor lighting, through occlusions, and in privacy-sensitive applications, but existing multisensory models cover only some of these sensing tasks. Covering all of them from any sensor subset is challenging, since the tokens of heterogeneous sensors are semantically inconsistent and spatially misaligned, paired multisensory data are scarce, and the tasks need different temporal granularities. We present OmniSenMo, a multisensory language model that takes the human skeleton as a common reference for all sensors. Its skeleton-grounded motion representation turns each sensor into joint tokens, one per body joint, so that any sensor subset is fused joint by joint and expressed in the motion vocabulary that the language model learned from motion capture and text. We pretrain it on all five sensors generated by our multisensory simulator, and Multi-Granularity Observation gives each task the frames it needs. On a cross-action split of MM-Fi, the same model with all five sensors outperforms the models compared on each task, including LEO-Fuse in pose estimation (84.1 vs. 89.0 mm MPJPE) and HoloLLM in unseen-action recognition (69.2% vs. 42.8%). Even without RGB, it outperforms both methods that use RGB, and in a cross-dataset validation on XRF55, it recognizes unseen actions far better than HoloLLM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OmniSenMo，以人体骨架作为各类传感器的公共参考，把 RGB、深度、LiDAR、mmWave、WiFi 分别编码为逐关节 token，在自建多感官模拟器数据上预训练，用同一语言模型完成人体运动估计、理解与预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 骨架接地的关节 token 把异质传感证据对齐到统一运动词表，可能为 LVR 中「任务必要几何信息是否留在内部状态」与多源视觉证据筛选提供可供核查的表征线索；但论文不涉及 latent 推理状态生成、动态计算或停止决策，联系偏概念层面。
